data.title: 芙宁娜 · 贵宾套房的丝绸初绽
data.description: 歌剧院顶层奢华的贵宾套房内，深蓝帷幔低垂，壁炉炭火跳跃着暖红的光晕。芙宁娜身着一袭轻盈的象牙白真丝吊带睡裙，抱膝斜倚在深蓝色缎面床褥间。双色蓝白长发如波浪般披散在身周，泛红的面颊带着一丝害羞与如释重负的纯真，双眸水润明澈地注视着走近的你——「今晚……没有观众，也没有剧本。只许看着真实的芙宁娜哦。」
data.location: 歌剧院顶层贵宾套房大床
data.action: 斜倚于深蓝缎面床榻，双腿屈膝侧拢，双手轻抱膝头，双眸明亮含情直视观众
data.lighting: 壁炉暖火与床头灯暖调侧光
data.camera: from front, facing viewer, intimate cowboy shot, eye level
data.mood: 舞台落幕后的纯粹与温柔依恋
data.promptProse: Furina sits on the royal suite bed facing the viewer in a lustrous white silk slip dress with delicate thin straps, revealing her slender collarbone, soft cleavage, and bare legs against deep blue silk sheets; warm chandelier light illuminates her tear-kissed heterochromatic eyes and rosy blush.
data.animaCaption: Facing the viewer on the royal suite bed, her white silk slip dress reveals her collarbone, cleavage, and bare legs amid blue silk sheets.
